builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-18, for the girls soccer build, over every 2025-26 varsity junior and sophomore (grades 11 and 10) on MaxPreps' 2025-26 roster pages and stat sheets for the 41 registry teams: name-by-name web searches for every sophomore and for all but 35 juniors (the session's web-search budget ran out), and, separately, TopDrawerSoccer's California class-of-2027 and class-of-2028 girls commitment lists read whole (349 players) and matched against every row; also the colleges' commitment tables on TopDrawerSoccer, SoccerWire's monthly commitment lists, PrepSoccer, MVLA's pages, school papers and the colleges' signing releases. Every quote was checked against its page as served or rendered that day.
notes: Players on the 2025-26 varsity teams who were juniors (class of 2027) or sophomores (class of 2028) that season, and whom a public page says have committed to, or signed with, a college team, in soccer or any other sport. The rules are data/commits.json's (README, "College commitments"); a player is named by the player registry's id, and grade is her 2025-26 grade. Last season's seniors are out of scope. Data only: no page reads this file yet.

Eight commitments, all in soccer, seven from the class of 2027 and one from 2028: Saara Lahtela (Homestead) and Teagan Kaefer (Los Gatos) signed with Santa Clara (its release of 2026-11-12 names both with their high schools); Abby Nelson (Los Gatos) to Cal, Avery Edson (Los Gatos) to Hawaii, Allison Park (Leland) to Illinois and Brooke Neschleba (Los Altos) to Brandeis, high confidence; Kailani Bock (Leland) to UC San Diego and Isabella Cain (Los Gatos, class of 2028) to Princeton, medium, each from TopDrawerSoccer's commitment lists matched by class year and hometown.

Recall is partial. The rows were 198 juniors and 166 sophomores (a few are one player under two spellings). 35 juniors got no name search once the session's web-search budget ran out (most of them at Del Mar, Fremont and James Lick), but every row was matched against TopDrawerSoccer's whole California class-of-2027 and class-of-2028 lists, which found Bock, Cain, Edson and Lahtela after the searches had not. calbears.com refused automated reads, so Cal's signing release of 2026-11-12 was not read and Nelson stays committed; Illinois' news feed could not be read either. The community colleges' athletics sites (PrestoSports) refused every read.
